6. This Court is of the considered view that the matter requires consideration.

Subject to the appellant's depositing the entire compensation amount along with the interest from the date of the institution of the claim as per the impugned award before the Registrar General of this Court within a period of four weeks, the operation of the impugned award dated 19 th April, 2024 shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The amount so deposited by the appellant shall be invested in an interest bearing FDR in an auto renewal mode.
7. List on 18th September, 2024 before Joint Registrar (Judicial) for completion of service and pleadings.
